title: Exact dish buried in search
description: An exact title query is ranked below many partial chicken matches.
evidence: Direct production text: 19 results; exact title شاورما الدجاج is 11th.
recommended_solution: Prioritize exact-title and phrase relevance for active searches; allow explicit user-selected sort.
status_and_limitations: Reverified direct URL; interactive behavior untested

title: Trend URL fails to establish trend order
description: Trend deep link returns default-like ordering rather than the promised sort.
evidence: First five identical to /discover; checkout ff75182 initializes sort to editor without reading query.
recommended_solution: Read and validate sort query parameter and visibly reflect selection; test navigation and refresh.
status_and_limitations: Reverified direct URLs; sort selector not clicked; deployment source hash not independently verified

title: Unrelated popular items labelled as nearest
description: No-match response calls fallback choices closest even when query is meaningless.
evidence: 0 results followed by قوارب البطاطا, صينية البطاطس, مربى التوت and تورتيلا الستيك; checkout fallback sorts by views.
recommended_solution: Label generic popular items accurately or provide demonstrably related suggestions.

title: Reviewed badge contradicts video-only copy
description: Three cards show written ingredients and steps but their reason still says video recommendation.
evidence: اختيارات الأسبوع: كرات الطاقة, قوالب البيض and لاتيه الفستق show مقادير وخطوات plus ترشيح فيديو; راجعي المصدر للمقادير والخطوات.
recommended_solution: Review stale editorial descriptions and derive status messaging from current review state.
status_and_limitations: Reverified production content; weekly selection may change

title: All creators rendered in home preview
description: Home contains full creator inventory despite a link to a creator directory.
evidence: Home reports 152 chefs; multiple retrieved chunks list them; local source creators.map renders all.
recommended_solution: Test a bounded diverse preview with link to the full directory; retain discoverability.
status_and_limitations: Content volume verified; mobile scroll burden not measured

title: Chicken doneness language implies time alone is sufficient
description: Recipe says 5 minutes on high heat are enough for sliced chicken without a safe internal-temperature check in the visible cooking step.
evidence: Step 2 says not more than 5 minutes; common errors say 5 minutes on high heat كفاية للشرائح. Time alone cannot establish safe doneness.
recommended_solution: Have food-safety editor review chicken recipes; explain that time varies and poultry must reach 74°C/165°F internally, without inventing source claims.
status_and_limitations: Production wording verified; cooking safety risk is an expert assessment, not an observed illness

title: Ingredient choices include spelling duplicates
description: Ingredient list includes multiple spellings for the same common term.
evidence: All ingredients list includes جبنة and جبنه, جبنة قريش and جبنه قريش, and قرفة and قرفه.
recommended_solution: Use canonical display terms with aliases for matching; keep genuinely different ingredient types separate.
status_and_limitations: Direct production text verified; selection behavior not tested

title: Account creation unavailable on observed deployment
description: The registration page reports accounts temporarily unavailable; DB health reports accounts false.
evidence: Register says الحسابات غير متاحة مؤقتًا; /api/health/db returns configured:false, connected:false, schemaReady:false, accounts:false.
recommended_solution: Investigate deployment configuration and availability; if intentionally disabled, clearly communicate guest-only limits and recovery expectations. Do not seed production without backup/review.
status_and_limitations: Production text and health response verified; login attempts and duration not tested

title: Conflicting claims about weekly plan sync
description: Registration says account sync includes plans; My Kitchen says weekly plan stays on device.
evidence: Register lists الخطط as synced; /kitchen explicitly says الخطة الأسبوعية لسه محلية.
recommended_solution: Make synchronization scope consistent and specific; if cloud sync is desired plan it separately with migration/conflict tests.
complexity: S for copy; L for sync
status_and_limitations: Both production text states verified; actual logged-in sync untested

title: Chocolate journey starts with mango ice cream
description: Chocolate-themed path presents mango ice cream as its first step.
evidence: رحلة الشوكولاتة calls for ice cream but first named and linked recipe is آيس كريم مانجا كريمي بـ3 مكونات. The linked mango ice cream recipe lists mango, sugar, cream and optional coloring, with no chocolate.
recommended_solution: Editorially review path membership and description; select a verified matching recipe or rename the journey.
status_and_limitations: Production passport and linked recipe text verified; visual state not tested
